import sys
import heapq

def max_score(t, test_cases):
    results = []

        a.sort()
        # Calculate the maximum possible score
        max_score = max(a[-1] - a[2], a[-2] - a[1], a[-3] - a[0])
        results.append(max_score)
    return results

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
